clue.text: Hid from new boss, almost better

indicators.note: new signals that the letters kept from boss come in a fresh order
almost means the word boss loses its final letter

parts.note: better in the sense of recovered from illness, i.e. cured

explanation.surface: Someone concealed information from an incoming manager, nearly a better course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims BOSS to BOS, which 'new' rearranges as OBS; add CURED.
explanation.definitionFit: To hide something is to conceal it from view, which is what obscuring it does.

clue.text: Offer to protect name creates a difficult situation

indicators.note: to protect means the bid wraps itself around the name abbreviation

parts.note: an offer at auction is a bid

explanation.surface: An offer of protection for a person's name leads to trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: A bind is an informal word for a tight spot or predicament.

clue.text: Reprimand leader missing in upset

indicators.note: leader missing tells us to drop the first letter of the synonym

parts.note: someone upset and frightened is fearful

explanation.surface: A ticking-off for a boss who disappeared during a disturbance.
explanation.definitionFit: An earful is a colloquial term for a scolding or telling-off.

clue.text: Plant singled out needing to absorb energy

indicators.note: to absorb means the rearranged letters take in the energy symbol
out signals that the letters of singled are put out of their order

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A particular plant, chosen for attention, needs to soak up energy to grow.
explanation.definitionFit: A seedling is a young plant grown from seed.

clue.text: Killjoy ruins drink

parts.note: to ruin something is to spoil it
port is a fortified wine

explanation.surface: A party pooper ruins the drinks.
explanation.definitionFit: A spoilsport is someone who ruins others' fun, a synonym for killjoy.

clue.text: He has a target of a run before church — then beer regularly

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for run

indicators.note: regularly means take every other letter of the word beer

explanation.surface: A man aims at a run before church and then has a beer now and then.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' picks the second and fourth letters of BEER, E and R.
explanation.definitionFit: An archer shoots arrows at a target, so it is a man with a target.

clue.text: A bid for change — queen finally made to give up

indicators.note: for change says the letters of A bid are altered in order

parts.note: a queen is a female cat

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of made

explanation.surface: A bid for reform means the monarch was at last forced to step down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for change' rearranges A BID as ABDI. 'queen' is a female cat, not the monarch the surface suggests.
explanation.definitionFit: To abdicate is to renounce a throne or responsibility, i.e. to give it up.

clue.text: Recalled and officially cancelled, lacking leader

indicators.note: lacking leader means the first letter of the synonym goes

parts.note: a licence officially cancelled has been revoked

explanation.surface: Something remembered and formally cancelled, without its head.
explanation.definitionFit: To evoke a memory is to bring it to mind, so evoked means called back to mind.

clue.text: Send abroad somebody skilful, with love for English

indicators.note: love for English means the zero letter replaces the English abbreviation

parts.note: a skilful person is an expert
love is zero in tennis, shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: Sending a skilled person overseas, swapping England for affection.
explanation.definitionFit: To export goods is to send them to another country for sale.

clue.text: One day accepting church is cold

indicators.note: accepting means the one-and-day pair takes the church abbreviation inside

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Someone says a single day of churchgoing leaves them chilly.
explanation.definitionFit: Iced means chilled or frozen, so it can stand for cold.

clue.text: Ladies with day left in struggle for illumination

indicators.note: in places the ladies-day-left string within the struggle synonym

parts.note: a struggle is a fight
the ladies is a toilet, informally a loo

explanation.surface: Women and a day off amid a scuffle for some light.
explanation.definitionFit: A floodlight is a powerful lamp giving broad illumination, as at a stadium.

clue.text: Single youth backed by brother of girl getting married

parts.note: single means one, the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: backed means the youth synonym is read in reverse

parts.note: a youth is a lad

explanation.surface: An unmarried young man is supported by the bride's brother.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backed' reverses the youth synonym, giving DAL. 'Single' looks like marital status but only gives a numeral.
explanation.definitionFit: Bridal is the adjective for anything belonging to a bride, a woman getting married.

clue.text: Fingerprints trapping members who in Paris will be failures

indicators.note: trapping means the fingerprints synonym encloses the other pieces

parts.note: dabs is slang for fingerprints
MPs are Members of Parliament
qui is French for who

explanation.surface: Police prints catch politicians who in France will flop.
explanation.definitionFit: A damp squib is an idiom for something that fails to live up to expectations, like a firework that fizzles.

clue.text: Government representative's misery, as sacked

definitions.note: the 's stands for is, joining the definition to the wordplay

indicators.note: sacked suggests the letters of misery and as are thrown about

explanation.surface: A government official is miserable at being fired.
explanation.definitionFit: An emissary is an envoy sent on a mission on behalf of a government.

clue.text: Fruit initially served in Rover's Return

indicators.note: in places the first letter inside the reversed word
Return means the rover synonym is read backwards

parts.note: a rover is a wanderer, a nomad

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of served

explanation.surface: Fruit first served at a pub called the Rover's Return.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Return' turns NOMAD into DAMON, with S from 'initially' inside. The Rovers Return is the pub in the British soap Coronation Street.
explanation.definitionFit: A damson is a small dark purple plum.

clue.text: Honestly shifting around — in a furtive way

indicators.note: shifting around says the letters of Honestly are moved about

explanation.surface: Honestly, someone is sneaking around secretly.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something on the sly means doing it secretly or furtively.

clue.text: Take no notice in revealing design or expression

indicators.note: revealing means the letters are shown within the run design or expression

explanation.surface: Disregard what a design or facial expression gives away.
explanation.definitionFit: To ignore something is to pay no attention to it.

clue.text: Excused retired European politician on trend, oddly

parts.note: ex means former, i.e. retired
MP is a Member of Parliament

indicators.note: oddly takes the first, third and fifth letters of trend

explanation.surface: A former Euro MP was let off for following fashion strangely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly' picks T, E and D from TREND; 'on' just joins.
explanation.definitionFit: To be exempted is to be freed from an obligation, i.e. excused.

clue.text: Standards to be aimed at in island trades

parts.note: trades or bargains are deals

explanation.surface: Goals to pursue in island commerce.
explanation.definitionFit: Ideals are principles or standards of perfection one strives toward.

clue.text: Tight-lipped and tense editor shut away

parts.note: a tight-lipped person is close, i.e. secretive
T is the grammar abbreviation for tense

explanation.surface: A secretive, nervous editor locked herself away.
explanation.definitionFit: Closeted means kept in private seclusion, as if in a closet.

clue.text: Freedom to move with little backing in place

indicators.note: in places the reversed little synonym inside the place synonym

parts.note: to place something is to lay it down

indicators.note: backing means the little synonym is read in reverse

parts.note: wee is Scottish for little

explanation.surface: Room to manoeuvre with small support in position.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' reverses the little synonym, giving EEW, which sits inside the place synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: Leeway is room for manoeuvre or latitude, the freedom to act.

clue.text: Television supporter of course gets somewhere to sit

parts.note: a television is a TV set
on a golf course a tee supports the ball

explanation.surface: A television and a golf stand make a place to sit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of course' reads as 'naturally', but it is the golf course.
explanation.definitionFit: A settee is a sofa, a piece of furniture for sitting on.

clue.text: Vessel carrying fruit — and weapons

indicators.note: carrying means the ship abbreviation holds the fruit inside

parts.note: SS stands for steamship
a pear is a fruit

explanation.surface: A ship transporting fruit, and arms too.
explanation.definitionFit: Spears are long pointed weapons for throwing or thrusting.

clue.text: Pay for entrée and a rum cocktail

indicators.note: cocktail suggests a mixture, so entrée, a and rum are mixed up

explanation.surface: Someone pays for a starter course and a rum-based drink.
explanation.definitionFit: To remunerate is to pay someone for work or services.

clue.text: John starts with a vacant pause, getting joke

parts.note: J is the abbreviation for John

indicators.note: vacant means emptied of its middle, leaving the outer letters of pause

explanation.surface: John begins with an empty pause before getting a joke.
explanation.definitionFit: A jape is a practical joke or prank.

clue.text: Project onset of endless growth

parts.note: to project is to stick out, i.e. jut

indicators.note: onset of takes the first letter of endless

explanation.surface: A project about the beginning of never-ending growth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Project' reads as a noun but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Jute is a plant grown for fibre, so it is a crop, a growth.

clue.text: Frisk doctor in prison

indicators.note: in places the doctor abbreviation inside the prison synonym

parts.note: gaol is the British spelling of jail
MB is a medical degree, Bachelor of Medicine

explanation.surface: Searching a medic in jail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Frisk' suggests a police search but means to skip about.
explanation.definitionFit: To gambol is to skip and leap playfully, the same as to frisk.

clue.text: Drink from quiet hotel in Kent area beside river

indicators.note: in places the quiet-hotel pair inside the area abbreviation

parts.note: Kent is a county in South-East England, SE
P is the musical notation for quiet
the Ritz is a famous London hotel

explanation.surface: A drink at a quiet hotel in Kent by the river.
explanation.definitionFit: A spritzer is a drink of wine mixed with soda water.
